description: Individual life insurance application: who is insured, who owns the policy, who is paid, what coverage is applied for and how it is funded.

insurer.description: The company issuing the policy and the form the application was made on.

company_name.description: Legal name of the insurance company the application is made to, as printed in the form header.

form_number.description: Form identifier printed in the page footer, e.g. NB5000NY.

form_version.description: Form version or edition date printed in the footer, e.g. 06/2012.

proposed_insured.description: Proposed Life Insured One: the person whose life is to be insured.

full_name.description: First, middle and last name of the proposed insured, joined with spaces.

sex.description: Sex as checked on the form.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as written on the form (month, day, year).

place_of_birth.description: State or region and country of birth.

residence_address.description: Primary residence: street, city, state and zip code.

years_at_address.description: Total years at the primary residence address.

earned_annual_income.description: Gross annual earned income in dollars.

unearned_annual_income.description: Gross annual unearned income in dollars.

net_worth.description: Net worth as written, e.g. '$2.6 M'.

purpose_of_insurance.description: Purpose of insurance box checked: Estate Conservation, Business Insurance, Wealth Transfer, Income Replacement or Other.

owner.description: Who is the owner (question 3): the box checked, e.g. Proposed Life Insured One, Proposed Life Insured Two, Trust, Business Partner, Employer.

beneficiaries.description: Beneficiaries listed in the Beneficiary Information section.

relationship.description: Relationship to the proposed life insured.

percentage.description: Share of the death benefit, in percent.

product_type.description: Flexible or fixed premium product checked, e.g. Universal Life, Variable Universal Life, Term 10.

lives_covered.description: Single Life or Survivorship, as checked.

base_face_amount.description: Base face amount applied for, in dollars.

death_benefit_option.description: Death benefit option checked, e.g. 'Option 1 (Face Amount/TFA)'.

riders.description: Riders and benefits checked. Empty if none are checked.

notices_sent_to.description: Who premium notices and correspondence go to (question 14a).

premium_source.description: Premium source checked in question 15, e.g. Earned Income.

is_replacement.description: Answer to question 19: will this insurance replace or change any existing policy. True for Yes.

total_coverage_pending_life_one.description: Question 21b: total formal coverage pending (including this application) for Life One, in dollars.

tobacco_use.description: Question 25 for Life One: ever used tobacco or nicotine products. True for Yes.

last_medical_consultation.description: Question 33, Life One's last visit to any doctor or physician.

date.description: Date of last visit as written.

reason_and_outcome.description: Reason for and outcome of the visit.

temporary_insurance_applied_for.description: False when the Temporary Life Insurance Agreement section is marked Not Applicable.
